READ: three fresh sets after question-role fixes

899/900 correct (99.89%) · 0 wrong · 1 unresolved

Frozen version 6; 300 new sentences per set, generated by unchanged Serpent constructors with independent graph-derived gold. No generative AI calls. Parsing does not require knowing the answer to a question.

SetCorrectWrongUnresolvedAccuracy
10300/30000100.00%
11300/30000100.00%
12299/3000199.67%

What this establishes

  • Only existing voice_tense grammar and existing vocabulary with new bindings; no new workflow families.
  • Literal role-slot scoring does not verify all semantics, including tense representation.
  • No active library, archive, ledger or correct-ASK evaluation in these 900 cases.
  • Final ASK is from missing calibration; do not count it as justified semantic ASK.
  • Fresh rule coverage is not a causal ablation tick; paired replay ticks are reported separately.

Source retention is 900/900 by design. All final routes are ASK because calibration remains absent. No production acceptance claim follows from these proposal scores. Each set exceeds 97.5% within this limited test scope.

Rules, ascending by observed replay benefit

RuleNew flips in saved 1,087Correct fresh cases covered
C019-ordered-double-object-roles10
C018-passive-question-role-normalization144114

C018 recognizes the complete BE + patient + optional not + participle + by + agent question when the dependency parser attaches the participle as a noun modifier. C019 uses a declared double-object verb and adjacent ordered noun phrases to assign recipient then patient. Neither rule hardcodes sentences or names.

Saved 1,087-case replay: 942 → 1087, 145 flips, 0 regressions. Older 600-case replay: 387 → 396, 9 flips, 0 regressions. These are reused development results; the older set still has 204 unresolved cases.

The parser labels “key” as amod under “moved”, and “moved” as attr under “Is”. C018 requires an explicit subject and acl attachment, so it abstains. This is a grammar coverage gap, not missing WORLD knowledge or semantic ambiguity. No post-test repair was applied.

Grounding and ASK boundary

Missing context, unresolved pronouns and ambiguous or stale knowledge prevent AI fallback. Model identity assignments require independent deterministic evidence; unsupported IDs trigger ASK. Grammar-only fallback remains possible. Nine focused policy tests pass. This does not implement a general history, participant or ordinal resolver; quoted reference words and complement “that” can conservatively block fallback. The trusted direct gate API still assumes its caller supplies authoritative bindings.

How scores were checked

All 900 inputs are unique and disjoint from sets 1–9. The frozen reader saw only source sentences; scoring loaded teacher gold after capture. Three audits recomputed scores and checked source, parser and reference hashes. The regression suite ran 238 tests: 237 passed, one optional dependency skip. Captures, failures, manifests and references are saved alongside this report.
